headline: PHP Keeps Its Engine Running
lede: The official PHP source repository contains the interpreter, Zend Engine, standard library, CLI, and the extensions that keep a mature web platform portable. Its build system and parallel test suite remain the working surface for contributors tuning runtime behavior, language features, and production reliability.

headline: Claude Learns the Shape of Work
lede: Anthropic’s plugin collection turns Claude into a set of role-specific operators through Markdown, JSON, skills, slash commands, and MCP connectors. The architecture is deliberately modular: map an organization’s tools and terminology into repeatable workflows, then let the agent execute within that blueprint.

headline: Ponytail Makes Less Code the Rule
lede: Ponytail gives coding agents a strict decision ladder: use the platform, standard library, or existing code before adding anything new. Its minimalism-first workflow targets bloated AI-generated implementations while preserving security, accessibility, and error handling.

headline: Security Audits Gain a Second Opinion
lede: Cloudflare’s security-audit skill breaks automated review into reconnaissance, hunting, verification, and evidence tracking. Independent validation agents and structured JSON ledgers separate confirmed flaws from leads and false positives, giving AI-assisted audits a more disciplined chain of proof.

headline: Graphify Connects the Whole Codebase
lede: Graphify turns source, documents, schemas, images, and diagrams into a queryable knowledge graph using deterministic extraction alongside model-assisted interpretation. Labeled edges, incremental caching, and exports for GraphML, Neo4j, Obsidian, and MCP keep the resulting map inspectable as the repository changes.

headline: Supabase Puts Postgres at the Center
lede: Supabase wraps PostgreSQL with authentication, generated APIs, realtime services, storage, and AI-ready extensions. Teams get a managed path for rapid delivery without giving up the relational database, self-hosting option, or portability of an open-source foundation.

headline: FastAPI Turns Types Into Working APIs
lede: FastAPI lets Python developers declare routes and data contracts with familiar type hints, then supplies validation, serialization, OpenAPI schemas, and interactive documentation. Its asynchronous foundations and tight Uvicorn workflow make a compact command-line-to-production path for services that need speed without ceremony.

headline: Claude Code, From First Prompt to Workflow
lede: Claude How To lays out a practical progression through commands, memory, hooks, MCP servers, subagents, and plugins. Copy-ready configuration, Mermaid diagrams, quizzes, and offline EPUB support turn a fast-moving toolset into a sequence developers can build and test one layer at a time.

headline: PCL Builds a Better Minecraft Launchpad
lede: Plain Craft Launcher brings reusable UI components, animation, downloads, and game-instance startup into one desktop workflow for Minecraft players. Its periodically synchronized source offers a concrete look at how a feature-rich launcher assembles presentation, asset management, and launch coordination.
